TCWHU Mobile App\nPrivacy Policy and Community Guidelines

Effective Date: November 2, 2025

Welcome to the TCWHU Mobile App. Your privacy, anonymity, and safety are our top priorities. By creating an account or using this application, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to the following terms and conditions.

1. Anonymity and Personal Information

To protect your safety and maintain a respectful environment, all users must remain anonymous within the platform.
You MUST NOT use your real name as your display name or nickname. You MUST NOT share personal identifying information in your profile, chats, or any public spaces within the app. Prohibited information includes:

   - Full name or surname
   - Phone number, address, or email
   - Class schedules or course sections
   - Personal social media accounts

2. Photo Verification (Administrator Access Only)

During sign-up, you must upload a selfie and your TCU ID for verification. These images are securely stored and accessible only to TCWHU administrators. Your visible profile avatar must be a non-identifiable emoji or cartoon image.

3. Safe and Respectful Communication

Be respectful in all interactions. Avoid harassment, bullying, hate speech, or explicit content. Use the “Report” feature to flag inappropriate behavior.

4. Account Violations and Enforcement

Admins may issue:
   - Warnings
   - Suspensions
   - Permanent bans
based on rule violations.

5. Data Privacy and Security

Your data is stored securely and never shared or sold. You can request account or data deletion anytime.

6. Agreement and Compliance

By checking “I Agree,” you confirm you understand and accept these terms. Together, we maintain a safe, respectful, and anonymous community.
